subject: Re: Renewal — AmpliTech: MSA redlines & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@amplitech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning + proposed capacity bump (Q4)

Hi Priyom / Ben,

Quick note as we head into renewal: Q3 usage came in higher than we expected and procurement has asked us to lock a larger committed capacity for Q4 to avoid overages. Attached is our Q3 usage export for reference (Attachment: AmpliTech_Q3_usage.csv (csv)).

High-level ask: can Redwood extend our term by 12 months with a 30% committed capacity uplift effective 2027-11-01? Were also hoping to keep pricing roughly inline but are open to a structured ramp.

Next steps from our side: procurement needs an updated order form + redlined MSA to review internally by Oct 15 so theyve got time to route a PO. Can your team put together a clean order form and call out any legal changes youd need to propose on the MSA?

Happy to jump on a quick call this week — Im free Thu 11-2 PT.

Thanks,
Sarah Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
AmpliTech
(Attachment: AmpliTech_Q3_usage.csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@amplitech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning + proposed capacity bump (Q4)

Thanks for the data, Sarah — helpful context. Well take a run at a proposal and draft order form today.

Immediate plan: Ben will model the new commit and pricing scenarios and circulate an order form (initial draft attached: AMP_renewal_draft_v1.docx). Lauren (legal) is ccd to review MSA-impacting items. From a product/ops standpoint we will validate capacity routing and any regional constraints for a Nov 1 start.

Two asks for your procurement team:
- Can you confirm whether the PO must reference a specific MSA effective date, or if a signed order form referencing the current MSA is sufficient?
- Is AmpliTech comfortable with a 12-month term extension (12 months from the current expiry) or do you want a calendar-year alignment?

Ive included the draft order form as an attachment; its got placeholders for pricing tiers and a provisional exhibit for the 30% uplift. Ben, please add the number scenarios and a recommended billing cadence.

Ill schedule a 30-minute call Thu 11:30 PT to walk through if that works — feel free to propose an alternate time.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: AMP_renewal_draft_v1.docx)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@amplitech.com>
Date: 2027-10-07T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning + proposed capacity bump (Q4) -- legal redline summary

Priyom / Ben / Sarah,

I reviewed the draft order form and did an annotated pass on the governing MSA. Ive attached a PDF with highlights (Attachment: Redwood_MSA_annotated.pdf). Summary of the material items legal will want to discuss / redline: 

1) Term language: need explicit start/end dates if procurement requires PO tie-in; propose clause that the order forms effective date governs.
2) Data retention & access: clarify logs and usage reporting cadence and retention period (we can be flexible but need the retention window documented).
3) Audit rights: limit to once-per-year and narrow to security/compliance scope; customer requested broader audit historically.
4) Indemnity & liability cap: recommend holding to the existing cap with carve-outs for willful misconduct; procurement may push higher.
5) Export controls / restricted data: redline clarifying responsibilities for data residency if AmpliTech chooses regional routing.
6) Exhibit (capacity): call out ramp schedule (30% uplift starting 2027-11-01 with staged billing) and define overage calculation.

Operational ask for sales: please indicate which of the above items are deal-breakers vs. negotiable. If procurement needs the PO to reference a specific MSA version, we can produce a short side-letter to avoid re-executing the full agreement.

Im attaching the annotated MSA and included inline comments in the order form. I can do a legal-run this afternoon if you want turn-around within 24 hours.

Notes: Sarah, when youre available on the call please flag any procurement constraints (PO timing, internal approvers).

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_MSA_annotated.pdf)

From: Sarah Patel <sarah@amplitech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, AmpliTech Procurement <procurement@amplitech.com>
Date: 2027-10-08T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning + proposed capacity bump (Q4)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement confirms: PO needs a final order form attached, referencing the current MSA is fine; they dont require re-execution of the entire MSA.

On the legal asks: audit rights and indemnity cap will likely be escalated but we can accept the proposed language if Redwood can commit to the staged ramp billing and provide an overage lookback for the prior quarter.

Timing: procurement needs an updated order form + redline summary by Oct 12 to route for internal approvals; target signature (DocuSign) by Oct 18 so we can process PO and have the new capacity live Nov 1.

Ill join the Thu 11:30 PT call to review details (or the alternate time if you propose one).

Sarah Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, AmpliTech
(Internal note: procurement will hold final approval until legal confirms final indemnity cap language)
